import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


# Define haversine distance function
def haversine(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    R = 6371  # Earth's radius in kilometers
    lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2 = map(np.radians, [lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2])
    dlat = lat2 - lat1
    dlon = lon2 - lon1
    a = np.sin(dlat / 2) ** 2 + np.cos(lat1) * np.cos(lat2) * np.sin(dlon / 2) ** 2
    c = 2 * np.arcsin(np.sqrt(a))
    return R * c


# Manhattan distance (in degrees)
def manhattan(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    return np.abs(lat2 - lat1) + np.abs(lon2 - lon1)


# Bearing function (angle from pickup to dropoff in radians)
def bearing(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2 = map(np.radians, [lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2])
    dlon = lon2 - lon1
    x = np.sin(dlon) * np.cos(lat2)
    y = np.cos(lat1) * np.sin(lat2) - np.sin(lat1) * np.cos(lat2) * np.cos(dlon)
    return np.arctan2(x, y)


# NYC bounding box (to filter out-of-area rides)
NYC_MIN_LAT, NYC_MAX_LAT = 40.47, 40.92
NYC_MIN_LON, NYC_MAX_LON = -74.26, -73.70

# Manhattan bounding box (more precise than NYC box)
MANHATTAN_MIN_LAT, MANHATTAN_MAX_LAT = 40.70, 40.85
MANHATTAN_MIN_LON, MANHATTAN_MAX_LON = -74.02, -73.93

# Manhattan centroid (approximate)
MANHATTAN_CENTROID_LAT = (MANHATTAN_MIN_LAT + MANHATTAN_MAX_LAT) / 2
MANHATTAN_CENTROID_LON = (MANHATTAN_MIN_LON + MANHATTAN_MAX_LON) / 2

# Airport coordinates for NYC
JFK_LAT, JFK_LON = 40.6413, -73.7781
LGA_LAT, LGA_LON = 40.7769, -73.8740

print("Loading data...")
# Load training data (increase sample size)
train_full = pd.read_csv("./input/labels.csv", nrows=4000000)
train_full["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(
    train_full["pickup_datetime"], errors="coerce"
)

# Load test data
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
test["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(test["pickup_datetime"], errors="coerce")


# Feature engineering function
def engineer_features(df, is_train=True):
    df = df.copy()

    # Datetime features
    df["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(df["pickup_datetime"], errors="coerce")
    df["year"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.year
    df["month"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.month
    df["day"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.day
    df["hour"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
    df["dayofweek"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
    df["is_weekend"] = (df["dayofweek"] >= 5).astype(int)
    df["is_night"] = ((df["hour"] >= 22) | (df["hour"] <= 5)).astype(int)

    # Peak hour surcharge features
    # Weekday rush hours: 7-10 AM and 4-8 PM on weekdays
    df["is_peak_hour"] = (
        (df["dayofweek"] < 5)
        & ((df["hour"].between(7, 10)) | (df["hour"].between(16, 20)))
    ).astype(int)
    df["peak_hour_surcharge"] = df["is_peak_hour"].astype(float) * 1.00

    # Compound surcharge features
    # Weekday night peak: 8-10 PM on weekdays (peak hour + night)
    df["is_weekday_night_peak"] = (
        (df["dayofweek"] < 5) & (df["hour"].between(20, 22))
    ).astype(int)
    df["weekday_night_peak_surcharge"] = (
        df["is_weekday_night_peak"].astype(float) * 2.00
    )

    # Weekend night surcharge: 8 PM - 6 AM on weekends (weekend + night)
    df["is_weekend_night"] = (df["is_weekend"] & df["is_night"]).astype(int)
    df["weekend_night_surcharge"] = df["is_weekend_night"].astype(float) * 1.50

    # Distance features
    df["haversine_dist"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
    )
    df["manhattan_dist"] = manhattan(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
    )

    # Absolute differences
    df["abs_lat_diff"] = np.abs(df["dropoff_latitude"] - df["pickup_latitude"])
    df["abs_lon_diff"] = np.abs(df["dropoff_longitude"] - df["pickup_longitude"])

    # Bearing feature
    df["bearing"] = bearing(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
    )
    df["bearing_cos"] = np.cos(df["bearing"])
    df["bearing_sin"] = np.sin(df["bearing"])

    # Manhattan-specific features
    df["pickup_in_manhattan"] = (
        (df["pickup_latitude"].between(MANHATTAN_MIN_LAT, MANHATTAN_MAX_LAT))
        & (df["pickup_longitude"].between(MANHATTAN_MIN_LON, MANHATTAN_MAX_LON))
    ).astype(int)
    df["dropoff_in_manhattan"] = (
        (df["dropoff_latitude"].between(MANHATTAN_MIN_LAT, MANHATTAN_MAX_LAT))
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"].between(MANHATTAN_MIN_LON, MANHATTAN_MAX_LON))
    ).astype(int)
    df["manhattan_trip"] = (
        df["pickup_in_manhattan"] & df["dropoff_in_manhattan"]
    ).astype(int)

    # Distance to Manhattan centroid
    df["pickup_to_manhattan_centroid"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        MANHATTAN_CENTROID_LAT,
        MANHATTAN_CENTROID_LON,
    )
    df["dropoff_to_manhattan_centroid"] = haversine(
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
        MANHATTAN_CENTROID_LAT,
        MANHATTAN_CENTROID_LON,
    )

    # Airport proximity features
    df["pickup_to_jfk"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"], df["pickup_longitude"], JFK_LAT, JFK_LON
    )
    df["pickup_to_lga"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"], df["pickup_longitude"], LGA_LAT, LGA_LON
    )
    df["dropoff_to_jfk"] = haversine(
        df["dropoff_latitude"], df["dropoff_longitude"], JFK_LAT, JFK_LON
    )
    df["dropoff_to_lga"] = haversine(
        df["dropoff_latitude"], df["dropoff_longitude"], LGA_LAT, LGA_LON
    )
    df["is_jfk_trip"] = ((df["pickup_to_jfk"] < 2) | (df["dropoff_to_jfk"] < 2)).astype(
        int
    )
    df["is_lga_trip"] = ((df["pickup_to_lga"] < 2) | (df["dropoff_to_lga"] < 2)).astype(
        int
    )

    # TOLL-ZONE INTERACTION FEATURES
    df["is_jfk_manhattan_trip"] = (
        (
            (df["pickup_in_manhattan"] & (df["dropoff_to_jfk"] < 2))
            | (df["dropoff_in_manhattan"] & (df["pickup_to_jfk"] < 2))
        )
    ).astype(int)
    df["is_lga_manhattan_trip"] = (
        (
            (df["pickup_in_manhattan"] & (df["dropoff_to_lga"] < 2))
            | (df["dropoff_in_manhattan"] & (df["pickup_to_lga"] < 2))
        )
    ).astype(int)
    df["is_high_toll_trip"] = (
        df["is_jfk_manhattan_trip"] | df["is_lga_manhattan_trip"]
    ).astype(int)

    # Distance-toll interactions
    df["haversine_dist_x_high_toll"] = df["haversine_dist"] * df["is_high_toll_trip"]
    df["manhattan_dist_x_high_toll"] = df["manhattan_dist"] * df["is_high_toll_trip"]

    # EXPLICIT TOLL COST INDICATORS
    df["jfk_airtrain_fee"] = (
        ((df["pickup_to_jfk"] < 2) | (df["dropoff_to_jfk"] < 2))
        & (df["haversine_dist"] > 1)
    ).astype(float) * 7.50

    df["bridge_tunnel_surcharge"] = (
        (df["dropoff_in_manhattan"] & ~df["pickup_in_manhattan"])
        & (df["is_night"] | df["is_weekend"])
    ).astype(float) * 5.75

    # NEW: Peak hour interaction features
    df["haversine_dist_x_peak_hour"] = df["haversine_dist"] * df["is_peak_hour"]
    df["manhattan_dist_x_peak_hour"] = df["manhattan_dist"] * df["is_peak_hour"]

    # NYC bounding box filter (only for training to remove outliers)
    if is_train:
        in_nyc = (
            (df["pickup_latitude"].between(NYC_MIN_LAT, NYC_MAX_LAT))
            & (df["pickup_longitude"].between(NYC_MIN_LON, NYC_MAX_LON))
            & (df["dropoff_latitude"].between(NYC_MIN_LAT, NYC_MAX_LAT))
            & (df["dropoff_longitude"].between(NYC_MIN_LON, NYC_MAX_LON))
        )
        df = df[in_nyc].copy()

    # Fill NaNs if needed
    if is_train:
        df = df.dropna()
    else:
        df = df.fillna(method="ffill").fillna(0)

    return df


print("Engineering features...")
train = engineer_features(train_full, is_train=True)

# Filter extreme outlier fares (as before)
train = train[
    (train["fare_amount"] > 0)
    & (train["fare_amount"] < 200)
    & (train["passenger_count"] >= 0)
    & (train["passenger_count"] <= 6)
]

feature_cols = [
    "pickup_latitude",
    "pickup_longitude",
    "dropoff_latitude",
    "dropoff_longitude",
    "passenger_count",
    "haversine_dist",
    "manhattan_dist",
    "abs_lat_diff",
    "abs_lon_diff",
    "year",
    "month",
    "day",
    "hour",
    "dayofweek",
    "is_weekend",
    "is_night",
    "is_peak_hour",
    "pickup_to_jfk",

    "dropoff_to_jfk",
    "dropoff_to_lga",
    "is_jfk_trip",
    "is_lga_trip",
    "pickup_in_manhattan",
    "dropoff_in_manhattan",
    "manhattan_trip",
    "pickup_to_manhattan_centroid",
    "dropoff_to_manhattan_centroid",
    "bearing",
    "bearing_cos",
    "bearing_sin",
    "is_jfk_manhattan_trip",
    "is_lga_manhattan_trip",
    "is_high_toll_trip",
    "haversine_dist_x_high_toll",
    "manhattan_dist_x_high_toll",
    "jfk_airtrain_fee",
    "bridge_tunnel_surcharge",
    "peak_hour_surcharge",
    "haversine_dist_x_peak_hour",
    "manhattan_dist_x_peak_hour",
    "weekday_night_peak_surcharge",
    "weekend_night_surcharge",
]

X = train[feature_cols]
y = train["fare_amount"]

# Stratified split by pickup hour to preserve temporal distribution
train_indices, val_indices = train_test_split(
    np.arange(len(X)), test_size=0.15, stratify=X["hour"], random_state=42
)

X_train, y_train = X.iloc[train_indices], y.iloc[train_indices]
X_val, y_val = X.iloc[val_indices], y.iloc[val_indices]

print(f"Training set: {len(X_train)} samples")
print(f"Validation set: {len(X_val)} samples")

# LightGBM datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train, params={"verbose": -1})
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, params={"verbose": -1})

# LightGBM parameters (unchanged from best previous run)
params = {
    "objective": "regression",
    "metric": "rmse",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

# Train with early stopping
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    callbacks=[
        lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False),
        lgb.log_evaluation(period=0),
    ],
)

# Evaluate on validation set
val_preds = model.predict(X_val)
rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean((val_preds - y_val) ** 2))
print(f"Validation RMSE: {rmse:.4f}")

# Prepare test data and generate predictions
test = engineer_features(test, is_train=False)
test_preds = model.predict(test[feature_cols])

# Create submission
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"key": sample_sub["key"], "fare_amount": np.maximum(test_preds, 0)}
)

submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
